generations.conceptPrompt: A 1989 electric fruit juicer for a village market stall in Eastern Europe, a mains-powered appliance bought new from a state shop: a motor base, a juice bowl and a spout where the juice runs out. A tall white enamel commercial juicer, the motor in the lower block, a steel bowl and a pulp drawer above it, a steel feed hopper with a wooden pusher. Single object, orthographic-style three-quarter product shot from slightly above, the whole object in frame, plain flat light grey background, soft even studio light, no hands, no stand, no text, no logos, no watermark.
